P-FLEXVERSE.Purpose: Declarative reactive UI ecosystem for RimWorld mod developers: behaviors, a reactive widget tree, Flexbox layout over Unity IMGUI, and a source-generation toolchain that removes modding boilerplate.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: FlexVerse runtime assembly consumed as a RimWorld mod dependency.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Behavior-based reactive state, animation, computed values and effect composition.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Widget tree with reconciliation, Flexbox layout, transformed input targeting, native rectangular child clipping, local paint order and Unity IMGUI rendering.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Build-time metaprogramming (Roslyn source generator, Fody IL weaving) for widget properties.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Planned-but-unimplemented capabilities are excluded from the implemented architecture.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Repository tooling — owned by the sibling project P-FLEXVERSE-TOOLING.
Scope.SCP-OUT-003: Test suites — deferred to the verification plane.

Principles.PRIN-001: Represent current accepted architecture and actual dependencies; never model planned work as implemented.
Principles.PRIN-002: A module is an independent behavioral contract, not every class or file; one module may span multiple files.
Principles.PRIN-003: Keep unverified modules visibly unverified until deterministic project gates exist; never invent passing evidence.
Principles.PRIN-004: All product logging flows through FlexVerse.Log with a grep-stable module marker contract.
Principles.PRIN-005: Build-time metaprogramming is isolated from the game runtime; they share only generated symbol names.
Principles.PRIN-006: Public widget APIs use flat reactive Props. View owns general decorative surfaces; specialized widgets own content and native control presentation. Decoration is composed around content without an independent Style object or replacement renderer.

Technology.TECH-001: C# on .NET Framework 4.8 inside RimWorld and Unity; netstandard2.0 for build tools.
Technology.TECH-002: Unity IMGUI for rendering and input; RimWorld mod loading via About.xml.
Technology.TECH-003: Roslyn source generators and Fody/Mono.Cecil for compile-time code production.
Technology.TECH-004: Verification branches: XUnit (offline, dotnet test) and Pickle (in-session RimWorld.Pickle scenarios); manual inspection via the Explorer window.
